preregistration.order: one seeded shuffle per tier; deadline truncation therefore leaves an unbiased random subsample
preregistration.partition: input_free=INPUTS, output_free=OUTPUTS, both known sets empty
preregistration.concurrency_rule: sum(memory caps) over concurrent measurement processes <= 12 GiB
preregistration.mem_cap_mechanism: shell `ulimit -v` (never RLIMIT_AS in a preexec_fn -- that turns bad_alloc into SIGSEGV and corrupts the taxonomy)
preregistration.denominator: analysed = HIT + NONE; never the corpus

caveats: All numbers are under Mealy semantics; every tlsf-fin file declares SEMANTICS: Finite,Moore (B3).
164 Two-player-Game instances exceed MAX_ARG_STRLEN and are reported as ARGV_TOO_LONG, an explicit exclusion (B1, ruled out of scope by the user).
The 25 real-TLSF files (Scutella, chomp_game) are outside the population; syfco dependency is Wednesday's decision.
The `xdep` field on deps rows is the sweep's inline parse, which swallows the extractor's `(of ...)` roster; certify.json carries the authoritative Xdep, cross-checked against the emitted part file.
